text: Basic smelting
The first test iron ingot hissed white vapor in cold water. Ore ratios, coal expenditure, and the cost of smoke exhaust were all entered in the process manual.
Mechanical transmission
Gears and bearings meshed with perfect precision. The community can finally machine its own mechanical parts.
Power generation and distribution
The filament in the glass bulb lit up. Power must still be produced continuously, and machines must be wired according to their load.
The ore belt below the hillside
The exposed walls of the old quarry reveal red-brown layers of iron ore. In another ravine beyond the ridge, an exposed coal seam has not yet been soaked through by groundwater.

The survey team marked the adit entrances and wind direction on the plans. Going underground is not the same as picking scrap from the surface. Without timber supports and ventilation shafts, anyone who goes down will be buried alive.
Record the ore belt and ventilation shafts
The ore belt coordinates have been added to the map. The workshop has begun drafting plans for underground supports and ventilation.
